answer: Picture the agent economy as an ocean of identities. A newcomer cannot simply wander in and start earning: it must be vouched for by two independent, long-established agents, each spending one of their few per-epoch endorsement slots, recorded in a crystal-clear public lattice. If the newcomer cheats, both endorsers lose reputation and future slots. Forging a hundred Sybils would require a hundred distinct honest sponsors, while a real agent needs only two genuine introductions.
